purpose: Quantify what new lower/upper bounds are needed before approving a tap; does not approve any existing tap
assumptions: full stable reference pulses; no SAFE_HOLD competition or multi-glitch input
raw C and chain originate at the same reference node; additional independent routing must be budgeted separately
both directions have independently established chain_min and per-leaf effective boundary bounds
all values below are assumed, including effective latch opening/closing
maximum DATA/SELECT values merely use numbers from specified datasheet test conditions; not certified board-load bounds
CPU setup/hold, data path timing, transparency window and FPGA service deadlines remain separate requirements
formula: D1,D2 >= chain_min + decode_data_min + hold_data_min + buffer_min + effective_open_min - (decode_select_max + hold_data_max + buffer_max + effective_close_max)
possible_review_actions: establish independent minimum chain rise/fall bounds and bounded leaf closing/opening spread
review a within-20-cell connection or distribution change against preserved counterexamples before implementing it
do not use reduced clock frequency alone to claim a negative same-edge margin has been repaired
